content.title: General Rules
content.text:
- Discord and in-game names must match
- Racism, sexual remarks, and excessive toxicity are prohibited
- Maximum of 5 soakers at one time
- Respect admins, players, and the server community
- Admins will not intervene in tribe insiding situations
- Trade scamming is prohibited
- Fake admin names or inappropriate nicknames are not allowed
- Tribe names must remain consistent across all maps
- Tribe hopping is not allowed
- No teaming or alliances in PvP situations

content.title: Raid Rules /  Banned Creatures & Items
content.text:
- Popcorning loot during raids is not allowed
- Maximum cage time is 24 hours after a ticket is submitted
- Meshing, hacking, or exploiting results in a permanent ban
- Teaming or alliances in PvP are prohibited
- Only one tribe may raid a target at a time
- Counter raiding active raids is not allowed
- FOBs must contain, at the very minimum, 50 Heavy Turrets, 50 Tek Turrets, and 1 Tek Forcefield
- Mesh biting is prohibited
- Raft raiding is not allowed
- Unusual raid methods must be recorded for proof if requested by admins


- Banned dinos: Dodorex, DodoWyvern, Candy Golems
- Banned items: Reaper Stone, Wyvern Stone, Griffin Stone

content.title: Structure Rules
content.text:
- Excessive structure spam may be removed by admins
- Maximum of 20 cliff platforms inside caves and 20 outside
- Maximum of 5 vaults per generator
- Spamming gates, billboards, transmitters, or similar structures is not allowed
- Floating structures and turrets are prohibited
- Lag-causing builds are not allowed

content.title: Base Rules
content.text:
- No excessive foundation spam outside of bases
- Base entrances must be accessible without exploits or special methods
- Building in mesh or under-map areas is prohibited
- Maximum of 2 bases per map per tribe
- Maximum of 3 cave bases total across all maps
- No building near spawn points or obelisks
- Tribe limit is 8 players
